wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 05-008 gates the wad-assets lane by asserting that every prerequisite step (05-001..05-007) has a committed COMPLETED status JSON with a recorded commitSha, a matching evidence JSON with zero knownFailures and a clean typecheck, and that the prerequisite's source wrapper module and focused test file both exist on disk. The gate test imports nothing from src/ — it operates purely on plan_final/status, plan_final/evidence, src/, and test/ filesystem state.
